For a Bengaluru–Delhi return, I’d shortlist these and compare the final round-trip price with checked baggage included:

Air India – Economy Basic/Value: ~₹8,500–₹9,000 one-way currently. Basic includes 15 kg checked baggage; Value includes 15 kg, while Classic gives 20 kg. 
Air India
+1

Verify: cancellation/change fee and refund timeline before payment.

IndiGo – standard fare: ~₹8,300–₹8,500 one-way on current listings. 
ixigo
+1

Verify: avoid Lite if checking bags; it can exclude checked baggage. IndiGo also offers a 48-hour fee-free “Look-in” period when eligible. 
IndiGo
+1

Akasa Air: ~₹8,300–₹8,500 one-way. 
ixigo

Verify: baggage allowance, cancellation fee, and whether the fare includes any flexibility.

For a family, compare the final return total after baggage—not headline fare.
